Package com.budgetapp.controller.features

Class BudgetController

java.lang.Object
com.budgetapp.controller.core.BaseController
com.budgetapp.controller.features.BudgetController
public class BudgetController extends BaseController
Controller responsible for managing budgets. Handles creating, updating, and validating budget limits for categories.
